notes.zh-CN: 浏览器面板改用 Safari 的标识访问网站：百度等站点不再返回「降级到 http」的页面，也就不会出现白屏和不停刷新。万一某个页面仍在自我循环跳转，面板检测到后会停止加载并提示，不再让页面无限转下去。
notes.en: The browser pane now identifies itself as Safari, so sites such as Baidu no longer answer with an https-to-http downgrade page, which is what caused the blank, endlessly refreshing tab. If a page still redirects itself in a loop, the pane stops it and says so instead of spinning forever.
